''See also: [[Valinhall Travelers Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[Valinhall]] [[Travelers]] are a rare and dwindling group of individuals associated with the [[Valinhall]] [[Territory]]. Unlike [[Travelers]] from other regions who summon external creatures, weapons, or elemental magic to fight, those from [[Valinhall]] draw power inward to enhance their own capabilities. This unique connection makes them exceptionally proficient in physical combat and allows them to neutralize the magical summons of other [[Travelers]]. They are often viewed as a specialized force designed for the purpose of eliminating other [[Travelers]], earning them the name the [[Dragon Army]]. The history of these [[Travelers]] is tied to a figure known as [[Valin]], or the The Wanderer{{!}}Wanderer, who arrived in [[the House]] of [[Valinhall]] and eventually established a gateway between worlds. [[The Territory]] itself was reportedly created through the experiments of [[Damasca]], though [[Valin]] turned its power against him. Because the relationship between the [[Territory]] and its [[Travelers]] requires a [[Founder]] to maintain balance, the absence of their original master led to a period of instability. Currently, only a small number of these individuals remain active.}}

== The Crimson Vault ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|[[Valinhall]] [[Travelers]] are a rare type of [[Traveler]] whose [[Territory]] was created rather than born. Described as twisted abominations, their purpose is to kill real [[Travelers]], and they are increasingly becoming a scarce breed. [[Simon]] is one such traveler, identifiable as a white-haired swordsman with a [[black gauntlet]] on his left hand and Shadow{{!}}shadow chain marks upon his arms. While [[Simon]] faces poisonous glances from [[Grandmaster Naraka]], he is part of a group that includes [[Indirial]] and two others. These individuals have specific duties to perform, including facing the The Wanderer{{!}}Wanderer once again and assisting [[Simon]] as they deal with events such as a [[Valinhall]] [[Traveler]] collecting [[Grandmaster Asphodel]]'s head in a sack.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[Valinhall]] [[Travelers]] are a type of entity or power capable of bringing down an [[Incarnation]], and they are distinguished by black chain-shaped marks on their hands, arms, or collars. This group includes individuals such as [[Andra Agnos]], [[Simon]], [[Kathrin]], Denner Weeks{{!}}Denner, and [[Caela]], though a [[graveyard]] holds the remains of eight deceased members. During recent events, [[Leah]] utilized two [[Travelers]] for a mission, including a young, cloaked man who carried a cracked [[sword]]. While these warriors can summon their blades from [[the House]] while in the outside world, [[Zakareth]] has identified them as a priority to either recruit or destroy.}}
